pipeline_cost.scope: Filtered source-table reads, aggregation, frozen numeric normalization, and dense feature materialization; separate from model inference. Same source files and feature width at each stay count.
pipeline_cost.cache_policy: OS cache not flushed; this is not hardware-cold I/O. Source hashes reused only when path, size and mtime are unchanged; hash time separately recorded.
pipeline_cost.limitation: Measured three patient subset sizes; does not establish distributed scalability or asymptotic complexity.

self_test: cluster-multiplicity review budgets match explicit duplicate-patient example
ties resolved by fixed stay ID; no label-dependent ties
limitations: Intervals condition on fixed models, observed cohorts and the chosen validation baseline; historical test exposure and training-population uncertainty are not included.
Subgroups are exploratory, not causal effects or proof of subgroup equivalence; calibration uses the same overall Validation-fitted calibrator.
Early-death exclusion is an outcome-conditioned retrospective LOS sensitivity analysis, not a replacement label, survival model or prospective deployment population.
Stress inputs are synthetic; MIMIC-III timing is specimen-based and does not establish measured result-availability robustness.
